dogecoin.text:
@dogecoin_empire Pretty cool. Because everything I ever "made" belongs to her. She spends. I manage the books. If we switched? Awesome. Disaster. Awesome disaster.

Nah. We've done what we were made to do. With excellence.

@dogecoin_empire No hidden meanings. Some obscure and oblique reflections. Because if our girl is thinking, she'll grasp the multiple, layered meanings. If she doesn't learn to think, just quit and speak plainly. Or get another girl. Higher levels of thought and communication are always good.
@dogecoin_empire If we can't be good at anything special, we're pretty sure y'all don't need us. I suspect lots of men are in this state of conviction.

@dogecoin_empire Women are perceived at being awesome in grace, hospitality, wisdom, and encouragement. But if they make a lot of money, can provide the goods for the family, then how are men supposed to complement that? Go to war? Fight off intruders? We ain't good at much else.

@dogecoin_empire Disparate dimensions. At least on different planes.

Answer is <null>.
@dogecoin_empire Awesome. Especially if that's an indicator of a transparent heart and a clear mind. Can't beat beautiful and real.

@dogecoin_empire Nope. A little fussing, once in awhile. Hating is a failure to be diligent in relationship commitment, development, and sacrificing for the other. When seeing the other as the one that "saved" you from despair, and live accordingly, things are pretty rosy.

@dogecoin_empire Early is best. They are often more objective judges of our needs in a mate. In my case, my mother met this girl back when we were friends; not even dating. She lit the fire under me. Told me to marry this girl. 47 years ago.

@dogecoin_empire Courage, even up to heroism, beat male "pretty" any day. Intelligence, though obtuse, is better than biceps. Confidence is better than wealth.

These statements are not revealing. Reality is. The types of men women chase are different than those they trust, admire, and value.

@dogecoin_empire What our hands touch:

Doorknobs.

Shaking hands.

Bar tops and stools; dining chairs.

Shopping cart handles.
@dogecoin_empire Posture and bearing are the foundation of beauty. Have we lost that art and skill?

@dogecoin_empire Usually. When I have so, I have met more interesting row mates. Scored an inflight upgrade. Awarded bottles of wine. It's been awesome how a stressful service so often births great rewards.
@dogecoin_empire Russians generally like their country and culture.

@dogecoin_empire Good lord, no. But successful at what? Doing the things men always did? If that's their schtick, we're not afraid of them but we might despise them for their effort to "be" men. We don't like men invading women's spaces. When are they going to quit invading ours?

@dogecoin_empire Oops. Men are not innately gifted in these matters. Wish we would learn and practice? Hard to teach Rottweilers how to act like Pomeranians. If you need heart, compassion, sincerity, commitment, and durability, maybe just accept them nihil se mutare?
@dogecoin_empire Ha. 49 years ago they dated. He's on wife #2 and retired with a fancy title. And still scared sh!tless of her. We see them annually or so.
@dogecoin_empire My "partner" owns my a$$ - lock, stock, and barrel. So I give her all the winnings. That's the deal. Always will be. And I'm the one who benefits the most.

@dogecoin_empire First, wealth is not the priority in the best relationships.

Second, observation is an truly excellent artform. Watch how they treat others when spending on dinner, shopping, tipping, etc. Watch for their desires and expectations for more stuff. Watch who and what they admire.
